## Change / Modification

What problem does this solve, and what changes for the player?
Quel problème est résolu et qu'est-ce qui change pour le joueur ?

## Validation

Describe tests performed and any remaining limits. For UI changes, include an
anonymized screenshot or offline preview.

- [ ] No private journals, account data or credentials are included.
- [ ] New dependencies, binaries, network access and workflow changes are disclosed.
- [ ] Relevant tests have been run, or the reason they could not run is explained.

Owner review is required before integration; permission to run CI is not approval to merge.
